              // source for consenting logged-out users. Read the cookie
              // directly so we get the stable anonymous id rather than the
              // $user_id that replaces it once a session is identified.
              function getMpUuid() {
                var match = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )mp_uuid=([^;]*)/);

                var data = new TextEncoder().encode(str);
